title: Impact of Medicaid Expansion on Uninsured Rates

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
- Method: Difference-in-Differences (DID) with two-way fixed effects (state and year).
- Why: We have panel data with treated (Medicaid expansion) and control states, and pre/post periods. DID compares the change in log uninsured rates in treated states post-expansion to the contemporaneous change in control states, netting out time-invariant state factors and common shocks.
- Estimand: The coefficient on treated × post (treat_x_post) gives the average treatment effect on the treated (ATT) in log points. We convert it to percent change as 100 × (exp(β) − 1).
- Key assumptions:
  - Parallel trends: In the absence of Medicaid expansion, the trend in uninsured rates for treated states would have matched that of control states.
  - No other simultaneous, treatment-specific shocks affecting uninsured rates.
  - Stable composition and no treatment anticipation effects.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load and analyze: Impact of Medicaid Expansion on Uninsured Rates (DID)

# -------------------------
# 0) Setup
# -------------------------
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
options(scipen = 999)

# Helper: cluster-robust inference using sandwich + lmtest if available
has_sandwich <- requireNamespace("sandwich", quietly = TRUE)
has_lmtest   <- requireNamespace("lmtest", quietly = TRUE)

cr_test <- function(model, cluster) {
  if (has_sandwich && has_lmtest) {
    vc <- sandwich::vcovCL(model, cluster = cluster, type = "HC1")
    ct <- lmtest::coeftest(model, vcov. = vc)
    list(ct = ct, vc = vc, ok = TRUE)
  } else {
    warning("sandwich/lmtest not available: falling back to conventional (non-clustered) SE.")
    sm <- summary(model)
    # Build a coeftest-like matrix
    cm <- cbind(Estimate = sm$coefficients[,1],
                "Std. Error" = sm$coefficients[,2],
                "t value"    = sm$coefficients[,3],
                "Pr(>|t|)"   = sm$coefficients[,4])
    list(ct = cm, vc = vcov(model), ok = FALSE)
  }
}

print_ci <- function(beta, se, level = 0.95) {
  z <- qnorm(1 - (1 - level)/2)
  c(beta - z*se, beta + z*se)
}

pct_change <- function(beta) 100*(exp(beta) - 1)

# -------------------------
# 1) Read data
# -------------------------
path <- "experiments/exp_b/data/s31_data.csv"
df <- read.csv(path)

# Basic sanity
df$unit_id <- as.integer(df$unit_id)
df$period  <- as.integer(df$period)
df$treated <- as.integer(df$treated)
df$post    <- as.integer(df$post)
df$treat_x_post <- as.integer(df$treat_x_post)
df$y <- as.numeric(df$y)

cat("Data loaded: N =", nrow(df), " | States =", length(unique(df$unit_id)),
    " | Years =", length(unique(df$period)), "\n")

# -------------------------
# 2) Quick descriptive check
# -------------------------
# Average log uninsured by group/time
pre_means  <- aggregate(y ~ treated, data = subset(df, post == 0), mean)
post_means <- aggregate(y ~ treated, data = subset(df, post == 1), mean)
cat("Mean log uninsured (pre): treated=", round(pre_means$y[pre_means$treated==1], 4),
    " control=", round(pre_means$y[pre_means$treated==0], 4), "\n")
cat("Mean log uninsured (post): treated=", round(post_means$y[post_means$treated==1], 4),
    " control=", round(post_means$y[post_means$treated==0], 4), "\n")

# -------------------------
# 3) Main DID: TWFE with state and year FE, clustered by state
# -------------------------
mod_did <- lm(y ~ treat_x_post + factor(unit_id) + factor(period), data = df)
res_did <- cr_test(mod_did, cluster = df$unit_id)

# Extract main coefficient
coef_name <- "treat_x_post"
if (!coef_name %in% rownames(res_did$ct)) {
  stop("Coefficient 'treat_x_post' not found in the model. Check data/coding.")
}
beta <- as.numeric(res_did$ct[coef_name, "Estimate"])
se   <- as.numeric(res_did$ct[coef_name, "Std. Error"])
pval <- as.numeric(res_did$ct[coef_name, grep("Pr", colnames(res_did$ct))])
ci   <- print_ci(beta, se, 0.95)

cat("\n=== Main DID Estimate (TWFE) ===\n")
cat("Beta (log points) =", round(beta, 4),
    " | SE =", round(se, 4),
    " | 95% CI [", round(ci[1], 4), ",", round(ci[2], 4), "]",
    " | p =", signif(pval, 3), "\n")
cat("Implied percent change in uninsured rate =",
    round(pct_change(beta), 2), "% ; 95% CI [",
    round(pct_change(ci[1]), 2), "%, ", round(pct_change(ci[2]), 2), "% ]\n")

# -------------------------
# 4) Event-study style check (common adoption year assumed)
#     - Interact treated with year dummies; reference = last pre year
# -------------------------
if (any(df$post == 0) && any(df$post == 1)) {
  ref_year <- max(df$period[df$post == 0])
} else {
  ref_year <- sort(unique(df$period))[1] # fallback
}
df$yearF <- stats::relevel(factor(df$period), ref = as.character(ref_year))

mod_es <- lm(y ~ factor(unit_id) + yearF + treated:yearF, data = df)
res_es <- cr_test(mod_es, cluster = df$unit_id)

# Collect ES coefficients for all years relative to ref_year
all_years <- sort(unique(df$period))
es_out <- data.frame(
  year = all_years[all_years != ref_year],
  est = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_
)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(es_out))) {
  yv <- es_out$year[i]
  nm <- paste0("treated:yearF", yv)
  if (nm %in% rownames(res_es$ct)) {
    es_out$est[i] <- as.numeric(res_es$ct[nm, "Estimate"])
    es_out$se[i]  <- as.numeric(res_es$ct[nm, "Std. Error"])
    es_out$p[i]   <- as.numeric(res_es$ct[nm, grep("Pr", colnames(res_es$ct))])
  }
}

cat("\n=== Event-study (relative to pre-year", ref_year, ") ===\n")
if (nrow(es_out) > 0) {
  # Print post-period effects
  post_rows <- es_out$year > ref_year
  if (any(post_rows, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    cat("Post-period effects (treated vs control, log points):\n")
    tmp <- es_out[post_rows, , drop = FALSE]
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(tmp))) {
      cat(" Year", tmp$year[j], ":",
          "beta =", round(tmp$est[j], 4),
          "SE =", round(tmp$se[j], 4),
          "p =", signif(tmp$p[j], 3), "\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("No post-period identified for event-study reporting.\n")
  }
  # Optional: simple pre-trend check (means of leads)
  pre_rows <- es_out$year < ref_year
  if (any(pre_rows, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    pre_beta_mean <- mean(es_out$est[pre_rows], na.rm = TRUE)
    cat("Mean of pre-period (lead) coefficients =", round(pre_beta_mean, 4), "\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Event-study interactions not estimable (check data).\n")
}

# -------------------------
# 5) Robustness: State-specific linear trends
# -------------------------
df$ctrend <- df$period - min(df$period, na.rm = TRUE)
mod_trend <- lm(y ~ treat_x_post + factor(period) + factor(unit_id) + factor(unit_id):ctrend, data = df)
res_trend <- cr_test(mod_trend, cluster = df$unit_id)

if (coef_name %in% rownames(res_trend$ct)) {
  b2  <- as.numeric(res_trend$ct[coef_name, "Estimate"])
  se2 <- as.numeric(res_trend$ct[coef_name, "Std. Error"])
  p2  <- as.numeric(res_trend$ct[coef_name, grep("Pr", colnames(res_trend$ct))])
  ci2 <- print_ci(b2, se2)
  cat("\n=== Robustness: DID with state-specific linear trends ===\n")
  cat("Beta (log points) =", round(b2, 4),
      " | SE =", round(se2, 4),
      " | 95% CI [", round(ci2[1], 4), ",", round(ci2[2], 4), "]",
      " | p =", signif(p2, 3), "\n")
  cat("Implied percent change =", round(pct_change(b2), 2), "%\n")
} else {
  cat("\nTrend model did not return 'treat_x_post' (check collinearity).\n")
}

# -------------------------
# 6) Placebo: DID within pre-period only (fake cutoff at median pre-year)
# -------------------------
pre_df <- subset(df, post == 0)
if (nrow(pre_df) > 0) {
  pre_years <- sort(unique(pre_df$period))
  fake_cut <- stats::median(pre_years)
  pre_df$fake_post <- as.integer(pre_df$period >= fake_cut)
  pre_df$fake_txp  <- pre_df$treated * pre_df$fake_post
  
  mod_placebo <- lm(y ~ fake_txp + factor(unit_id) + factor(period), data = pre_df)
  res_placebo <- cr_test(mod_placebo, cluster = pre_df$unit_id)
  
  if ("fake_txp" %in% rownames(res_placebo$ct)) {
    bp  <- as.numeric(res_placebo$ct["fake_txp", "Estimate"])
    sep <- as.numeric(res_placebo$ct["fake_txp", "Std. Error"])
    pp  <- as.numeric(res_placebo$ct["fake_txp", grep("Pr", colnames(res_placebo$ct))])
    cip <- print_ci(bp, sep)
    cat("\n=== Placebo DID (pre-period only) ===\n")
    cat("Beta (log points) =", round(bp, 4),
        " | SE =", round(sep, 4),
        " | 95% CI [", round(cip[1], 4), ",", round(cip[2], 4), "]",
        " | p =", signif(pp, 3), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("\nPlacebo coefficient not found (check data).\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("\nNo pre-period data for placebo test.\n")
}

# -------------------------
# 7) Summary message
# -------------------------
cat("\nAnalysis complete. Key output above includes:\n",
    "- Main DID ATT in logs and implied percent change\n",
    "- Event-study coefficients by year (post relative to last pre)\n",
    "- Robustness with state-specific linear trends\n",
    "- Placebo DID within pre-period\n")
```

## 3. Expected Findings
- Sign: Negative. Medicaid expansion should reduce the uninsured rate in treated states, so the log uninsured rate declines.
- Magnitude: For state-level aggregates, a reduction on the order of 0.25 to 0.35 log points is plausible, implying roughly a 22% to 30% decline in the uninsured rate relative to controls. The event-study should show near-zero pre-trends and negative post-period coefficients that are stable or grow in magnitude over time. Robustness with state-specific trends should not materially alter the sign or the magnitude.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Compare changes in uninsured rates over time between treated and untreated states.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: The expansion of Medicaid coverage significantly reduces the uninsured rate.
